hook.rumour: Have you heard? Sledges coming down from Pale Pass are being taxed twice—once by Countess Carvain's gate-reeves and again by the Legion detachment—while sealed crates slip through the snows unchecked.
hook.notice: BY ORDER OF CASTLE BRUMA & THE NORTHERN LEGION: Caravanners holding duplicate Pale Pass tariff receipts are to present their tallies at the Bruma gatehouse immediately.

stages.objective: Inspect the contested Pale Pass toll-ledgers at Bruma's northern gatehouse
Question the stranded Nord timber-drovers at Bleaker's Way about the midnight collectors
Return the counterfeit wax impressions to Captain Burd and the Legion quartermaster in Bruma

consequence_detail.summary: Both Castle Bruma and the Legion realise a third party has been stamping forged customs receipts along the snow-road.

stages.objective: Examine the sledge-tracks leading off the Bruma highway toward Fort Dragonclaw
Clear the false-livery toll collectors out of Fort Dragonclaw and seize their iron signet-press
Deliver the recovered waybills to the caravanners waiting at Bleaker's Way

objectives.text: Examine the sledge-tracks leading off the Bruma highway toward Fort Dragonclaw

consequence_detail.summary: The signet-press at Fort Dragonclaw is captured, revealing ciphered dispatches from a syndicate calling itself the Council of Ash.

stages.objective: Carry the ciphered Ash-Syndicate tablet from Bleaker's Way up the mountain trail
Consult the old Blades chronicler at Cloud Ruler Temple to decode the Reman-era pass map
Scout the snow-choked customs vaults at Fort Pale Pass where the contraband is cached

consequence_detail.summary: With Cloud Ruler Temple's old maps, the hidden smuggling gallery beneath Fort Pale Pass is laid bare.

stages.objective: Storm the inner customs vault at Fort Pale Pass and defeat Factor Corvus Bellor's guard
Seize the Council of Ash bullion chest and the true Imperial toll-charter
Witness Countess Carvain and the Legion legate sign the Pale Pass Tariff Concord in Bruma
